raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Rows from the new 'v2' collector have timestamps 6 hours ahead of the legacy rows: v2 activity starts at 12:00 while legacy starts at 06:00, and some v2 txn_ts values even fall after the batch's 02:00 ingest time. This looks like UTC versus local time (UTC-6), and it pushes late-evening v2 transactions into 00:00-06:00 of the next day, creating the spurious 2026-01-19 rows. Normalizing v2 timestamps by subtracting 6 hours in silver restores correct txn_ts and txn_date, and the gold tables rebuild from that.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
